**Applications of DC Series Motor:**
1. Electric traction (trams, trains).
2. Cranes, hoists, and elevators.
3. Conveyors and heavy-duty industrial drives requiring high starting torque.

**Applications of DC Shunt Motor:**
1. Lathe machines, drilling machines, and milling machines.
2. Centrifugal pumps and blowers.
3. Fans, conveyors, and constant-speed machine tools.
proTip: Never start a DC series motor on no-load because it will run at dangerously high speeds (runaway speed).
